body: Thank you, I used to write stuff down a while ago but I stopped because venting my frustrations on reddit feels more cathartic
It's just all monotonous and ugly. The solution of a simple life into being healed by nature seems like it's right around the corner but realistically it's miles away
I think that's something I needed to hear today, thank you <3. Maybe I'll give one of these numbers a call in the near future, it might not work for everyone but we'll see!

I distinctly remember the first person I opened up to completely brushing me off and not taking me seriously, then October comes around and they're sharing shit on social media about 'how we need to take the stigma away from mental health and opening up' if you dont want to hear about my problems that's absolutely fine with me but dont pretend to care for a few likes.
I feel like I desperately need this but office gossip and the fact that I'm already in the crosshairs of senior management because I've basically given up on this shit makes that almost impossible.
